# Maintainability instructions
Inspect before editing. Prefer the smallest coherent change and reusable names over copied logic. Preserve compatibility unless a breaking change is approved. Keep diffs reviewable, error states explicit, resources disposed, docs synced and dependencies purposeful. Reject speculative abstraction, hidden global state, infinite retries and silent failures. A refactor must preserve behavior with regression evidence.
